consumer: The frontend map renderer reading the tile snapshot, asking 'what terrain/furniture glyph should I draw at this tile in the map view?'
scope: Per-tile, filtered through the player's visibility/LOS and map-memory so out-of-sight tiles show the last-seen (remembered) appearance, not raw current world state
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles — its per-tile loop calls ctx.m.ter(p)/ctx.m.furn(p), which return the RAW authoritative terrain/furniture at the tile, bypassing the engine's visibility filtering and map-memory display path
divergence: A wall the player saw earlier is smashed to floor while out of sight: the GUI map view still DISPLAYS the remembered t_wall, but raw m.ter(p) returns t_floor, so the surface reports floor where the display shows wall
